panel_setup.title: Rubetek panel setup
panel_setup.description: Request a new 8-digit panel activation code through support in the official Domonap app. The code is exchanged for a panel session once. If the panel is already activated, import a saved session without reusing the code.

panel.title: Rubetek panel activation
panel.description: Enter the 8-digit panel activation code received from Domonap support. The code is used only to obtain the panel session and is not stored in Home Assistant.

panel_session.title: Import existing panel session
panel_session.description: Paste JSON containing instanceId, deviceInfo, panel and completeToken. This does not use an activation code. Do not publish this JSON because it contains credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Domonap needs to re-authenticate this integration. Continue to send a confirmation code to the saved phone number.

error.external_sip_domain_invalid: SIP domain must be host or host:port

init.title: External SIP / Asterisk
init.description: When enabled, Home Assistant registers on the configured SIP server and calls the configured number for each incoming Domonap call. Home Assistant bridges SIP signaling only: the original Domonap SDP offer is sent to Asterisk unchanged and Asterisk's SDP answer is sent back to Domonap unchanged. RTP flows directly between Domonap and Asterisk; NAT, RTP handling and transcoding belong on Asterisk. DTMF 1 is accepted as SIP INFO. A successful door open from DTMF, Home Assistant or Telegram ends the current call on both SIP legs. If the external SIP party hangs up without opening the door, the remaining Domonap call is terminated. UDP is currently supported. SIP support is experimental.

data_description.external_sip_call_number: For example: 100; configure the SIP leg toward Home Assistant with dtmf_mode=info for DTMF 1
data_description.call_end_mode: answer — accept the call before ending it (200 OK mutes the intercom panel, then BYE). reject — decline the call right away (603, does not mute the panel, faster on unreliable SIP).
